# diff

A session's code diff in the dashboard — a size-row button, Unified, Split and Review views, ticks and comments kept with the session.

Read first: `docs/features/diff/spec.md`, `docs/features/diff/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/diff-comments-anchor-by-quote-ticks-by-content` — Diff comments re-locate by their quoted lines and are kept as outdated when lost; review ticks key on the change's content. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-comments-anchor-by-quote-ticks-by-content.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-counts-polled-for-focused-session` — The dashboard polls a diff-counts endpoint for the focused session every 5 s while visible and in Focus; nothing is pushed. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-counts-polled-for-focused-session.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-entry-button-in-size-row` — The way into the diff is a button at the right end of the pane's size row, present only while there is something to open. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-entry-button-in-size-row.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-follows-launch-directory-checkout` — The diff is of the whole git checkout the session's launch directory is in, never the checkout Claude has moved to. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-follows-launch-directory-checkout.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-open-view-never-redraws` — An open diff never redraws by itself; a fingerprint mismatch shows a bar under the toolbar, and Refresh is the only redraw. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-open-view-never-redraws.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-read-only-git-cli` — The diff is read through the git CLI and never writes to the repository; a rename shows only as git reports it. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-read-only-git-cli.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-review-on-session-row-per-item-writes` — Diff comments and ticks live in one column of the session row, written per comment and per tick set, never broadcast, deleted by Remove. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-review-on-session-row-per-item-writes.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-uncapped-first-pass` — The diff is sent and drawn whole, with no size cap, no folding and no on-screen-only rendering; only large or NUL-holding untracked files read as binary. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-uncapped-first-pass.md`
- `kb:adr/diff-viewer-in-dashboard-comments-stay-local` — The dashboard shows a session's code diff with comments kept for the developer; nothing from the viewer reaches Claude Code. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff) → `docs/adr/diff-viewer-in-dashboard-comments-stay-local.md`
- `kb:adr/process-render-fixtures-record-diff-opt-in` — A render fixture records a session's diff and review only for scenarios that opt in; every other fixture answers the diff GETs 404 and shows no button. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff, connection) → `docs/adr/process-render-fixtures-record-diff-opt-in.md`
- `kb:adr/process-render-harness-diff-writes-default-404` — The render harness serves a fixture's recorded diff GETs but leaves the review writes at its default 404; a test that saves routes them to 204. (accepted, 2026-11-20; features: diff, connection) → `docs/adr/process-render-harness-diff-writes-default-404.md`
